purpose: Next bounded physical local-response identification after formal0/100 and failed goal-residual gain grid; no PPO training or hardware
physical_preparation: Each case independently performs the original real reach/manual release/frozen7s grasp; exact prefix physical/controller/camera/RNG/model signature required; failed prefix counts and is never resampled
base_action: Frozen100k actor with only active goal matrices replaced by measured prefix-end orientation; unvalidated neutral-goal diagnostic reference
probes: One reference plus +/- pulse on each of16 motor action channels:33 physically integrated cases
measurement: World rotation vector and position relative to reference at the same physical time; record actual commands/joints, forces and contact bodies. Simulator truth is scoring/identification only, never an actor input
fit: Central finite differences estimate local residual-action to6D object-motion response, including physical delays, motor coupling and contacts; do not assume a rigid sticking grasp or treat analytic motor Jacobians as passive-joint-aware
one_optional_validation: If the bounded local fit supports it, solve one minimum-norm action residual within +/-0.04 per channel for2deg world-Z motion and zero off-axis/translation, then physically test that one candidate from the identical independently executed prefix
constraints: Original action clipping,0.8rad/s velocity,2rad/s^2 acceleration, ROM, all2ms force/penetration/excluded-support and release-origin displacement audits; every abort retained
unchanged_physics: No friction/contact-dimension/solver tuning, pose injection, velocity clearing or reset to a successful simulator snapshot
scope: Local0.5s control-authority measurement only; not the7s rotation task or acceptance. No formal2611 reuse, no trained-policy relabeling
